name: Gym Fee Dues Report
query:
SELECT
  `tabGym Registration Form`.name as "Registration:Link/Gym Registration Form:150",
  `tabGym Registration Form`.member_name as "Member Name:Data:150",
  `tabGym Registration Form`.phone_number as "Phone Number:Data:120",
  `tabGym Registration Form`.subscription_plan as "Plan:Data:120",
  `tabGym Registration Form`.total_fee as "Total Fee:Currency:110",
  `tabGym Registration Form`.fee_paid as "Fee Paid:Currency:110",
  `tabGym Registration Form`.balance as "Balance Due:Currency:110",
  `tabGym Registration Form`.status_of_fees as "Status:Select/Fully Paid,Partially Paid,Not Paid:120",
  `tabGym Registration Form`.date_of_registration as "Registered On:Date:120"
FROM `tabGym Registration Form`
WHERE `tabGym Registration Form`.docstatus = 1
  AND `tabGym Registration Form`.balance > 0
ORDER BY `tabGym Registration Form`.balance DESC
